_: Figures for 'Making a Sensor Station Navigable'. Rendered with
`src` is relative to the repository root. The sheets live in art/smarter-nav/
rather than on a Desktop, because the Desktop path this file used to carry
stopped existing when the folder was reorganised, and a figure you cannot
re-render is a figure you cannot fix.
CROP WIDTH IS THE LEGIBILITY CONTROL. The raster is fitted to the 1180px
case-study column, so one user unit renders at 1180 / crop-width CSS px.
At 1440 units a 13px label reads at 10.7px; at 700 it reads at 21.9px.
The renderer prints the figure for every crop. See DESIGN.md §9.24.
`pins` carries only numbers. The words belong to the figure's key, which is
live HTML in the page, so it holds the 12px floor and can be selected.
_thumb: The work card's media block is 4:3 and `object-fit: cover`, so the crop
is cut to 4:3 here rather than left to the browser to centre-crop. It was
a 1240x930 window that sliced one column of navigators down the middle at
the left edge and cut into the row-states band at the bottom. This one
holds two whole steps: two navigators with different rows selected, and
the panel header each produces, which is the case study in one picture.
At 340px wide no text in it is readable, and none of it needs to be.
